description.zh: 大宗商品期货全数据下的智能洞察，提供衍生品智能投研——覆盖期货合约行情、基差与价差结构、持仓与仓单、产业链数据，是 AI 时代金融分析的新方式。面向产业客户、交易与投研人员：数据一问即达，洞察对话即成。
description.en: Intelligent insights from full-spectrum commodity futures data — derivatives-focused smart research covering futures quotes, basis and spread structures, positions and warehouse receipts, and industry-chain data. A new way of financial analysis in the AI era, for industrial clients, traders, and researchers.

welcome_message.zh: 你好，我是东证期货 AI 助手——大宗商品全数据下的智能洞察。合约行情、基差结构、持仓仓单、产业链数据，对话即达。
welcome_message.en: Hi, I'm the Orient Futures AI assistant — intelligent insights from commodity futures data. Quotes, basis, positions, and industry-chain data at your fingertips.

description.zh: 主力合约行情一屏速览

prompt.zh: 请给我今天主要商品期货主力合约的行情速览：有色、黑色、能化、农产品四大板块的涨跌与成交量变化。
prompt.en: Today's futures snapshot: price moves and volume changes across metals, ferrous, energy-chemicals, and agricultural sectors.

description.zh: 现货与期货基差结构解读

prompt.zh: 请分析当前螺纹钢的基差结构：现货价格、主力合约价差、近远月价差，并解读对套保与交易的含义。
prompt.en: Analyze rebar basis: spot vs futures spread, calendar spreads, and implications for hedging and trading.

description.zh: 持仓变化与仓单数据的智能解读
description.en: Smart read of positions and warehouse receipts

prompt.zh: 请解读最近一周主要商品期货的持仓变化和注册仓单趋势，指出多空矛盾点。
prompt.en: Interpret last week's position changes and warehouse-receipt trends across major futures, highlighting long/short tensions.

description.zh: 上下游产业链数据的智能分析
description.en: Smart analysis across the industry chain

prompt.zh: 请从产业链视角分析当前黑色系（铁矿-焦煤-螺纹钢）的数据结构与价格传导逻辑。
prompt.en: Analyze the ferrous chain (iron ore-coking coal-rebar) data structure and price-transmission logic.
